decisions.statement: A session is anonymous or throwaway or the real user.
Every sort of session names the environment that session needs.
A page that answered an error or landed on sign-in is not waited on to settle.
A hydration marker is waited on ahead of expected text.
Expected text is waited on ahead of a populated root.
A check with no discriminating signal is said to have no signal rather than passing.

definition: what a render check decides before it drives the browser, from the flags it was given
